title: Preventing Pipe Bellies in Horizontal Drainage
description: Proper support placement is critical for maintaining an unbroken grade along horizontal gravity drainage piping. When pipe hangers or strap supports are spaced too far apart, flexible plastic piping materials like ABS and PVC sag under the weight of water and suspended solids. These low points, known in the trade as bellies, retain standing water and trap heavy organic debris or grease. Over time, recurring blockages develop at these low spots. Always follow code-compliant support spacing, anchor hangers to rigid structural framing, and verify pitch with a torpedo level.
